title: Taxonomy backfill
desc: Assigns standard product/service categories (UNSPSC) to older tenders and suppliers so matching and search work everywhere.

title: Work packages
desc: Splits large programmes into packages that can each be tendered separately.

title: Catalog
desc: Product and service catalogue used for quick quotes and BOQ lines.

title: Vendor intel
desc: Supplier risk and performance signals: reviews, appeals, debarment checks and history.

title: Engagements
desc: Service engagements and quote requests between buyers and suppliers.

title: Vendor requests
desc: Requests raised by suppliers (category additions, help, corrections) waiting for PMC action.

title: Profile changes
desc: Supplier profile changes (bank, address, directors) that need approval before they take effect.

title: Marketing
desc: Campaigns, digests and WhatsApp/email outreach to suppliers.

title: Escrow institutions
desc: Banks and escrow providers onboarded to hold EMDs and award payments.

title: Awarded auctions
desc: Results of completed reverse auctions and the resulting awards.

title: DocuSign
desc: Electronic signature envelopes for award letters and contracts.

title: Suggested banks
desc: Banks suggested by users to be added as escrow institutions.

title: Stakeholder reports
desc: Board and sponsor reports: tender volumes, savings, timelines and compliance.

title: Alerts
desc: Tender alerts and notifications for the supplier's categories.

title: Messages
desc: Messages with PMC and buyers, including clarifications.

title: Signatures
desc: Documents waiting for the supplier's e-signature (agreements, contracts).

title: Reverse auctions
desc: Auctions the supplier is invited to, with live bidding.

title: Categories
desc: The categories the supplier works in; drives tender matching and alerts.

title: Account & security
desc: Login email, password, phone and security settings.
